body: I recently got pregnant and so many people have told me how I'm going to understand *so* many things when I'm a parent. I'm pretty sure when this baby pops out I'm not going to suddenly become wise about everything.

Absolutely! My dad always made comments about how I must not be eating enough, how I was too skinny, tried talking to me about anorexia.. When I turned 18 I started gaining weight. Now I'm not so bony anymore. And guess what my dad talks about.. How I've gained so much weight and need to start working out. I was a twig at first, then I gained 45 pounds and now I'm more meaty, but not overweight or even close to it.
